name: Reposilite
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Reposilite is a lightweight repository manager for Maven artifacts, for publishing and mirroring Java libraries. Manage it from its web interface and console.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Reposilite: downloads Reposilite from its own Maven repository and checks
# it against the published checksum. Repositories, the database and
# settings are never touched; the jar is only replaced once the new one
# has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

base=https://maven.reposilite.com/releases/com/reposilite/reposilite
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$@"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

meta=$(get "$base/maven-metadata.xml") || fail "maven.reposilite.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
latest=$(sed -n 's:.*<release>\(.*\)</release>.*:\1:p' <<<"$meta")
version="${REPOSILITE_VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] && version="$latest"
grep -q "<version>$version</version>" <<<"$meta" ||
    fail "Reposilite has no version $version. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest."

# Reposilite 3 ships an -all jar with its dependencies; older ones don't.
url="$base/$version/reposilite-$version-all.jar"
sum=$(get "$url.sha256" 2>/dev/null) || { url="$base/$version/reposilite-$version.jar"; sum=$(get "$url.sha256") || fail "Reposilite $version has no checksum to check the download against. Choose another version."; }
sum=$(cut -d' ' -f1 <<<"$sum")

if [ -f reposilite.jar ] && [ "$(sha256sum reposilite.jar | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Reposilite $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Reposilite $version"
    get -o reposilite.jar.new "$url"
    [ "$(sha256sum reposilite.jar.new | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f reposilite.jar.new; fail "The download didn't match Reposilite's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f reposilite.jar.new reposilite.jar
fi
echo "Installed Reposilite $version. Create an access token on the console with: token-generate admin m"

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Reposilite version to install, such as 3.6.7, or latest.
